remarks: This charming 3-bedroom, 2-full bathroom Cape Cod blends timeless character with modern luxury. Nestled on a quiet, divided street in a highly desirable city neighborhood, this property offers a peaceful retreat without sacrificing urban convenience. The heart of the home is a gorgeous designer kitchen (remodeled 2021) featuring premium finishes, custom cabinetry, and high-end appliances. This extensive remodel showcases beautiful Brazilian teak floors, custom doors, and exquisite woodwork throughout—including a custom-built television cabinet above the fireplace paired with a matching built-in unit to neatly tuck away your media electronics. The classic Cape Cod layout offers comfortable living spaces including three spacious bedrooms and two full bathrooms. One of the standout features of this property is the long cement driveway leading to a large 2-car detached garage featuring brand-new siding (2026). The garage includes a full attic above, providing massive amounts of extra storage or the perfect canvas for a future workshop or creative studio.Behind the scenes, the home offers ultimate comfort and efficiency with major mechanical and infrastructure upgrades: Complete Climate Control (2021): Equipped with a new furnace, central air conditioning, and an integrated humidifier for year-round comfort. Upgraded Electrical: A brand-new 200-amp electrical panel (2026) to effortlessly handle all modern power demands. Ample Hot Water: A generous 50-gallon water heater installed in 2023.Enjoy the best of city living on a quiet, low-traffic street. You are just minutes away from everything you need; Commuter's Dream: Convenient access to the local subway line for a quick commute. Neighborhood Amenities: Walkable to vibrant local shops and highly-rated restaurants. Don't miss the opportunity to own this rare gem that perfectly pairs neighborhood tranquility with city convenience.
